verdict.rationale: Activepieces is explicitly a workflow automation platform where 'Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions' and can 'Move data, send messages and update records between 764 apps without writing glue code,' confirming app-event-triggered workflows across many connected services. This is core functionality for a Zapier-alternative product. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/examples of specific trigger types (new record, new message, email received, form submission) and independent hands-on verification of trigger reliability.
